name: officefc
description: OfficeFC — an Expo and Firebase app for office EA Sports FC leagues, ELO ratings, and confirmed match tracking.

scripts.test: npm --prefix functions run build && node --test test/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:rules: npm --prefix functions run build && node scripts/test-rules.mjs
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run version:check && npm run typecheck:mobile && npm run build:web && npm run test:all && npm run test:rules:compiled
scripts.deploy:web: npm run build:web && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.deploy:backend: npm run validate:web-env && firebase deploy --only firestore,storage,functions
scripts.deploy:mvp: npm run build:web && firebase deploy --only firestore,storage,functions,hosting
scripts.test:all: npm --prefix functions run build && npm --prefix functions run test:compiled && npm --prefix mobile run test:compiled && npm run test:compiled
scripts.performance:check: npm --prefix functions run build && node scripts/benchmark-performance.mjs
